label: High Distress and Loneliness
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively higher loneliness along with elevated depressive and anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: More likely to be female, have graduate-level education or above, and report more than 5 hours.
behavior_markers: Higher mean depressive symptoms on PHQ-9
Higher mean anxiety symptoms on GAD-7
tone: Vulnerable, emotionally strained, and socially disconnected

label: Low distress and low loneliness
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms overall.
demographic_anchor: Most anchored by male respondents with graduate-level education or higher and 1-3 hours in the referenced time-use category.
behavior_markers: Reports relatively low loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure
Shows low depressive symptom levels on the PHQ-9
Shows very low anxiety symptom levels on the GAD-7
Represents a lower-distress respondent pattern overall

label: Higher loneliness with comparatively lower depression and anxiety
summary: Respondents in this profile report relatively elevated loneliness while showing comparatively lower average depressive and anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: More likely to be female, have graduate-level education or above, and report 1-3 hours in the referenced time category.
behavior_markers: Reports higher average loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure
Shows lower average depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9
Shows lower average anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7
Represents a training-split subgroup of 317 respondents
tone: Socially disconnected but not marked by equally high emotional distress on depression or anxiety measures.
